sections.title: Headline
sections.content: AI agent infrastructure dominates today's signal: web agents, agent orchestration, local decision models, and parallel coding-agent runtimes occupy most of the leading positions. The strongest individual momentum is concentrated in fast-moving Python and Go projects, while TypeScript remains prominent in production-oriented agent tooling.

sections.title: NandhaKishorM/laya
sections.description: Fast web agent focused on speed and low cost.

sections.title: eternity4719/HowToLiveBetter
sections.description: Evidence-oriented Chinese-language life guide covering health, finance, law, work, and family topics.

sections.title: mizorewww/laya-mlx

sections.title: Albert-Weasker/niubigeo
sections.description: Open-source AI brand-visibility and competitor-reporting tooling.

sections.title: jaredpalmer/kev

sections.title: deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness
sections.description: Plugin-oriented harness for building and extending agent systems.

sections.title: stablyai/orca
sections.description: Development environment for running fleets of parallel coding agents across desktop, mobile, and remote runtimes.

sections.title: Mak5er/AirCard
sections.description: Apple Wallet card customization tool for iOS 18+ without a jailbreak.

sections.title: Trending Technologies and Themes
sections.content: Agent runtimes and orchestration dominate; local and efficient inference is a secondary cluster; AI visibility is an emerging applied-tooling category. Python and TypeScript each appear in three of nine entries; Go, HTML, and Swift appear once.

sections.title: Notable Shifts
sections.content: The list is shifting from standalone chat or model repositories toward operational infrastructure: orchestration runtimes, parallel-agent environments, plugin systems, and specialized decision models.

sections.title: Takeaway
sections.content: Today's snapshot is primarily an agent-engineering snapshot. The strongest themes are orchestration, local inference, and practical evaluation or visibility tooling.
